description:
Music video directed by Ai Niina for the song Tsubame by YOASOBI with midories.

Note: The song featured in this music video is also used as the theme song to the NHK children SDGs program "Hirogare! Irotoridori". There also exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on December 2, 2021 and an English version of the song titled "The Swallow" also by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 3, 2022.
